coalitions.name: Mass Power Forward
coalitions.description: Statewide coalition of climate, environmental, and EJ organizations pushing comprehensive MA climate policy.

projects.name: Utility Influence Dashboard
projects.description: Public dashboard quantifying campaign donations from utilities and their senior employees, to show utility influence on Massachusetts climate policy. Debuted Sept 29, 2026.

events.name: Utility Influence Dashboard launch (press conference)
events.description: Mass Power Forward debuts its dashboard on utility campaign donations. Speakers: Vick Mohanka (Sierra Club MA) and Scotia Hille (Act On Mass). Live-streamed.

coalitions.name: Massachusetts Youth Climate Coalition
coalitions.description: Youth-led statewide coalition of school clubs and youth groups organizing for climate justice in Massachusetts.

projects.name: MA Climate Coalition Map
projects.description: This map: an interactive network of Massachusetts climate organizations, events and projects, kept up to date by each organization's point person through simple forms.

projects.name: 2026–27 member representative (vote caster) refresh
projects.description: Each member organization names its vote-casting representative for the 2026–27 year, and prospective members identify themselves. Organizations facing setbacks are asked to say so.

projects.name: MYCC × Cross Campus Climate Coalition collaboration matching
projects.description: MYCC and CCCC are pairing member organizations to collaborate and build stronger bonds. Interested organizations sign up through a form.

projects.name: Annual Advocacy Day preparation
projects.description: Member organizations are encouraged to meet their local legislators and build relationships before next year's Advocacy Day.

events.name: MYCC full-coalition call
events.description: Full-coalition call, every other Sunday 8–9 pm. Open to member organizations, returning members and prospective members. Agenda and Zoom link come from MYCC.

coalitions.name: Environmental Justice Legislative Table
coalitions.description: Coordinated table of orgs advancing EJ legislation at the State House.

coalitions.name: Green Justice Coalition
coalitions.description: EJ-led coalition centering frontline communities in climate, energy, and environmental decision-making.

coalitions.name: Climate Resilient Schools Coalition
coalitions.description: Coalition organizing for climate-resilient, equitable school infrastructure investments.

coalitions.name: HERO Coalition
coalitions.description: Coalition pushing efficient, electrified, equitable homes and buildings policy.

events.description: Jewish frameworks for meeting interlocking psychological, social, economic and climate challenges.

events.name: Plastic Pollution: Health, Climate, and Solutions
events.description: Why plastics are a systems problem (and a fossil-fuel product), and the scale of solution needed.

events.name: Two Eco-Poets: A Conversation About Climate
events.description: Poets Andy Oram and Deborah Leipziger read and discuss, facilitated by Rabbi Katy Allen.

projects.name: CREATE farmer mutual aid
projects.description: Cultivating Relationships: Education | Action | Tending Earth. Volunteers join local farmers for work shifts through the season; sign-up form required.

projects.name: Miyawaki mini-forest group
projects.description: Climate Action Now's working group on Miyawaki-method mini-forests and local biodiversity.

projects.name: No Clearcut for Profit (Eversource tree clearing)
projects.description: Campaign led by Western Mass Towns for a Responsible Grid, promoted by Climate Action Now: a petition asking the Governor to limit Eversource's tree clearing across 11 towns, ahead of Eversource's Final Environmental Impact Statement (around December).

events.name: Fall Gathering: Nurturing biodiversity in a time of ecological chaos
events.description: Potluck and connection at 5:30 pm; interactive program 6–7:30 pm with Owen Wormser and Matt Verson, hosted by the Miyawaki Forest Group. RSVP appreciated.

projects.name: Protect the Quabbin, Ware and Wachusett watershed forests
projects.description: Sierra Club MA Forest Protection Team campaign to make these watershed forests, which supply fresh water to nearly half of Massachusetts residents, permanent reserves with minimal human intervention. Petition open; film screenings raise funds.

events.name: Forest film screening: Old Growth Forests, Nature's Biotic Pump
events.description: Doors at 7 pm with pizza (vegan options included); film, then a half-hour panel and Q&A. Raises money for the watershed forest campaign. RSVP required.

events.name: Forest film screening (virtual): Old Growth Forests, Nature's Biotic Pump
events.description: Film followed by a panel with Susan Masino and Bill Stubblefield. Registration required.
